analyses.description: Incremental nonlinear static analysis with explicit solution control: direct Newton-Raphson load control, or indirect cylindrical arc-length control for limit points and snap-through. Unlike Static Structural, OOFEM treats the loads reached at each step as the load INCREMENT of that step, so a constant load history walks the equilibrium path in equal increments and reaches nsteps times the reference load.

params.name: Number of Steps
params.description: Number of solution increments. The total applied load is the accumulated per-step increment, not the load at the final step time.

params.name: Control Mode
params.description: 1 = direct control (Newton-Raphson load control), 0 = indirect cylindrical arc-length control. The two modes drive different OOFEM solvers, so their parameters are disjoint; arc-length control additionally requires Arc-Length Step.

params.name: Stiffness Mode
params.description: 0 = tangent stiffness, 1 = secant, 2 = initial elastic, 3 = secant updated per load step.

params.name: Relative Tolerance
params.description: Relative convergence tolerance for the iteration norms.

params.name: Maximum Iterations
params.description: Maximum equilibrium iterations per solution step.

params.name: Time Step
params.description: Length of one solution step in the time-function argument.

params.name: Reference Load Mode
params.description: 0 = the step increment is the total load assembled at the step time (the OOFEM default), 1 = the step increment is the load increment between step times, which leaves a constant load history with no load at all.

params.name: Modified NR Steps
params.description: Number of iterations reusing the stiffness before it is reassembled (modified Newton-Raphson). 0 keeps the full method.

params.name: Minimum Iterations
params.description: Minimum equilibrium iterations forced per solution step.

params.name: Minimum Step Length
params.description: Smallest admissible step length before the solver reports divergence.

params.name: Update Elastic Stiffness
params.description: 1 writes the valueless updateelasticstiffnessflag keyword, which refreshes the elastic stiffness used by the secant and elastic stiffness modes. 0 or empty omits it.

params.name: Arc-Length Step
params.description: Maximum arc length per step. Required by, and valid only for, indirect control (Control Mode 0).

params.name: Initial Arc-Length Step
params.description: Arc length of the first step. Indirect control only.

params.name: Arc-Length Psi
params.description: Weight of the load term in the arc-length constraint; 0 controls displacements only. Indirect control only.

params.name: Required Iterations
params.description: Iteration count the arc-length step adapts towards. Indirect control only.

params.name: Maximum Restarts
params.description: Number of step restarts allowed after a failed increment. Indirect control only.

params.name: Renumber
params.description: 1 renumbers equations each step; 0 keeps the initial numbering.

params.name: Initial Guess
params.description: Initial-guess strategy passed to the linear solver.

params.name: Linear Solver Type
params.description: OOFEM linear-solver type.

params.name: Sparse Matrix Type
params.description: OOFEM sparse-matrix storage type.

params.name: Relative Force Tolerance
params.description: Relative convergence tolerance on the force norm.

params.name: Relative Displacement Tolerance
params.description: Relative convergence tolerance on the displacement norm.
